title: I was ill
summary: A student gets ill, sees a doctor and misses school.

sentences.zh: 我没吃早饭，也没去学校。
sentences.en: I didn't eat breakfast, and I didn't go to school.
Mum said: 'Let's go to the hospital.'

sentences.zh: 我们坐出租车去了医院。
sentences.en: We went to the hospital by taxi.

sentences.zh: 医生说：'你要多喝水，多睡觉。'
sentences.en: The doctor said: 'Drink lots of water and sleep a lot.'

sentences.zh: 医生还说：'这几天不要吃冷的东西。'
sentences.en: The doctor also said: 'Don't eat cold things for the next few days.'

sentences.zh: 回家了，我睡了三个小时。
sentences.en: Back home, I slept for three hours.

sentences.zh: 下午，我的同学给我打电话。
sentences.en: In the afternoon, my classmate phoned me.

sentences.zh: 今天我好了，明天我去上学。
sentences.en: Today I'm better; tomorrow I'll go to school.

questions.prompt: What didn't the student do yesterday?
why: They did go to the hospital: 去了医院.

questions.prompt: How did they get to the hospital?
why: Right: 我们坐出租车去了医院.
They took a taxi, not walked.
No plane — 出租车 is a taxi.

questions.prompt: What did the doctor say NOT to do?
why: The doctor said to drink lots of water.
The doctor said to sleep a lot.
Right: 我的同学给我打电话.
